description: Canonical Realm reducer profiles. A Realm selects exactly one profile through its reducer-profile singleton control cell.
registry_rules: profile_id MUST use the ak.reducer.*.vN namespace and is immutable once stable.
A receiver selects the profile from the Event's authenticated CBA governance basis. Ordinary Events and federation service bindings do not declare a reducer profile.
ak.realm.create supplies the genesis profile. ak.realm.upgrade is interpreted by the source profile and writes the target profile to the same singleton control cell.
An upgrade is valid only when the source profile declares the target in upgrade_edges and the declared deterministic state transition succeeds.
Every active profile requires conformance vectors for admission, cell projection, lattice join, state root, security frontier, genesis, and upgrade behavior.

profiles.description: Arkret v1 Realm consensus semantics for every active durable reducer-input Event.
